packs.name: Forgotten Memories 32x32 tileset
packs.creator: Immunity
packs.permissions: Edit and use in personal and commercial projects; no repackaging or redistribution of the files (so private-assets; imported pieces only).
packs.used_for: B14-07: its laid-stone paving, reduced 1/2 (box) with step lines, is the cut-steps tile drawn over a cliff's rim (game/assets/terrain/steps.png; tools/terrain_art.py). Its stone ramps are side-on slopes for a 32 px terrace look and its brick paving reads as paving, not steps, at one 16 px world tile: not used for the steps themselves.
packs.opportunities: Stone ramps for open-pit terraces (MIN-A, with the pits' terrace art); fences (4 styles) for pens and fields; animated water and waterfalls (6 frames) for plateau streams; colour-variant trees and bushes for forest variety (as Living Forest-style trees). No cart, wagon, wheelbarrow or horse.
packs.scale: 32 px tiles drawn at the world's pixel density: 1:1, each tile covering 2 x 2 world tiles
packs.known_issues: The .rar copy has a truncated WaterTiles file; the zip is complete and is the source.

packs.name: Animal Farm Project Sprite Pack 1.0
packs.creator: Single Head Games
packs.permissions: Bought by the owner; free for personal and commercial use, may modify; original files not redistributed (private-assets).
packs.opportunities: The horse: a draught animal (the plough's deferred 'draught animal', then carts) and the first horse in the game; it needs a source (a manor stable pen in the village map, or the caravan) and the owner's choice of role. Bull, ram, rooster, sow, piglet, calf, lamb and chick: same species as Cozy Farm's in another style; not mixed in, so the pens keep one look.
packs.scale: 96 px cells, the horse about 80 px long: scale 1/3 (box) to about 27 px, against a 24 px Cozy cow and a 14 px human
packs.known_issues: 1.0 arrived as a .rar; extracted with unar into private-assets/Animal_Farm_Project_Sprite_Pack_1.0 (byte for byte).
packs.used_for: Imported, not yet in play: the horse sheet (game/assets/animals/farm_horse.png, tools/animal_farm.py, 1/3 box to 32 px frames, a 28 x 22 px horse) and AnimalSprite's 'farm' layout (stand, walk, graze; wildlife_test). Waiting on the owner's choice of how horses enter the village and what they do (CLAUDE.md section 11).

packs.name: Free Pixel Art Plants for Farm
packs.creator: Craftpix.net
packs.permissions: Craftpix file licence (craftpix.net/file-licenses): use in games, no redistribution of the files (private-assets).
packs.opportunities: Plum and yellow-fruit trees (new fruit items); crop growth stages for the existing crops (wheat, carrot, potato, herb) where they read better than Cozy Farm's; produce crates as storefront and stall displays (the storefront counter is a stand-in); produce icons; grapes on vines and sunflowers. Palms and pineapples do not fit an English medieval setting.
packs.scale: Trees and crops drawn at the world's pixel density: 1:1
packs.used_for: Apple trees (5 growth stages and the fruiting stage; tools/craftpix_plants.py): orchard trees by the houses that bear apples, felled and replanted like any tree (INT-147).
packs.known_issues: The pack has no stump or cut art: the stump is the mature tree's foot and the notches are drawn by the import tool. The grass patch under each tree is a slightly different green from the village grass.
